contract.authority: explicit captured assetID and entire Project plus mediaRoot snapshot; current UI selection does not redefine the chosen asset
contract.selectionChange: allowed; preserves current selection and relinks only captured asset
contract.sameIDRevisionChange: reject stale prepared result; preserve newer user edit
contract.documentReplacement: reject or cancel old result; never modify replacement project

scenarios.evidence: Before awaiting prepared relink, changed section/hierarchy/track selection without editing Project; captured asset path alone updates, unrelated asset preserved, new selection retained, one musical revision and one Undo added; candidate checksum unchanged.
Before MainActor commit, changed tempo using mutate with same project ID. Later relink rejected; tempo/revision/Undo/user dirty preserved, missing asset path unchanged, candidate checksum unchanged.

Before MainActor commit, replaced Project with new ID and clean dirty state; late work drained; replacement project remains byte-equivalent by model equality, no assets introduced, dirty remains false, candidate checksum unchanged.
Existing test still rejects same-name wrong content and supports Undo after verified candidate relink.

ordering: Tests do not suspend between relink dispatch and selection/document change. Thus queued MainActor publication cannot run before change, independent of detached checksum speed.
notVerified: Actual NSOpenPanel selection/cancellation and native repaint
Native user switching selection or documents while hash scan is visibly running
Audible playback or valid audio decoding; fixtures verify exact file bytes and SHA identity only
validationBoundary: Actual detached relink preparation, filesystem reads and ProjectMediaWorkspace commit lifecycle in XCTest. No native UI PASS claimed.
